{{Quote|You misjudge, I don't deal in the cosmetic. I craft grace, and power, and immortality.|Proh'ven|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Proh'ven''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In the [[Network Access]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] he contracted an individual to test the combat capabilities of a new type of [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
